items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to Piaget's view that thought precedes language and the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis of linguistic relativity.

items.title: GCSE Psychology: Language, Thought and Communication — Sapir-Whorf Hypothesis
items.description: GCSE-focused podcast episode on the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis and the debate over whether language shapes or follows thought.

items.title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
items.description: TED Talk by leading cognitive scientist Lera Boroditsky presenting evidence from cross-cultural research that supports the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis.

items.title: How Does Language Influence Thought? (Intro Psych Tutorial #87)
items.description: Concise tutorial covering the Whorfian hypothesis and the evidence for and against language determining thought.

items.title: Language, Thought and Communication: GCSE Psychology
items.description: Revision video covering all three subtopics of the AQA GCSE unit, including Piaget versus Sapir-Whorf.

items.title: Arrival (2016)
items.description: Sci-fi film in which a linguist deciphers an alien language and finds that learning it changes how she perceives time — a cinematic take on the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis.

items.title: The Science behind Arrival: Sapir-Whorf Hypothesis
items.description: Explains the real psychology and linguistics behind the film Arrival, making the strong and weak forms of the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis accessible.

items.title: BBC Bitesize — AQA GCSE Psychology
items.description: Bitesize hub covering Language, Thought and Communication with revision notes, videos and quizzes for AQA GCSE.

items.title: AQA GCSE Psychology specification
items.description: Official AQA spec — check the exact Piaget and Sapir-Whorf content you need for the language and thought exam question.
